preflight.frontend_build: npm run build:media passed before release and again in the locked remote build

backend: copy the exact candidate backend while excluding runtime caches and local virtual environments
verify the candidate source manifest and SessionPrincipal composition
update the Media systemd drop-in, restart, and verify health and readiness
frontend: copy exact managed source while excluding node_modules and generated dist output
invoke the official locked entrypoint with a temporary backend sibling used only by source QA
build, bind, seal, and atomically switch the immutable frontend release
transport_and_guards: make the managed Node toolchain authoritative inside the locked deployment entrypoint
add only location = /media/api/session to the production Nginx authority
require canonical and compatibility session responses to be byte-identical while a neighboring legacy route remains 404

guards.rollback: restore the prior systemd drop-in and frontend symlink on release failure; restore prior Nginx and verifier files on transport-guard failure

required: candidate and remote source identities agree
backend process uses the r4 settings path
frontend and backend coordination metadata agree
disk, loopback, and external index hashes agree
canonical and exact compatibility session routes return the same unauthenticated response
wrong-method, trailing-slash, and neighboring legacy routes remain closed
